bounded_check.method: Direct translation of pinned JSkat source predicates, all six game types, every distinct lead card, every unordered two-card own hand excluding the lead

limits: Static source translation only. JSkat Java runtime is unavailable here; callback state, card-set construction and actual Java parity remain unverified. No host adoption or strength claim.
mapping: JSkat getPlayableCards delegates each own card to isCardAllowed. Suit/Grand require a trump when led and held; otherwise a nontrump led suit when held. Null follows physical suit, including Jacks. V2 category and legal_cards use the same categories.
